_note: Source-grounded entry for EQUIDERMA AI. Unsupported fields are intentionally null or empty.
description: A localized cutaneous drug reaction that recurs at the same site after re-exposure to the causative medicine.
causes: Delayed hypersensitivity reaction to a medication
risk_factors: Previous exposure to the causative drug

appearance.general: One or more sharply demarcated round or oval erythematous or dusky patches that may blister and later leave pigmentation.

warning_signs: Multiple lesions, mucosal involvement, extensive blistering, or systemic symptoms require prompt medical evaluation.
doctor_discussion_points: Bring the medication list and note which drug was taken before the lesion appeared.
